title: Analytics: the $now anchor's addDays offset cannot read a related record's column (SLA per contract type) — and os validate passes the dotted path the runtime refuses
body:
Filing gate: ③ platform gap (consumer-blocking), plus an author-time hole, measured on @objectstack 18.2.0 (hotclm PR #168, as the head of legal).

**What is missing.** #25808 closed with ruling A. The now-anchored comparand `{ $now: true, addDays: { $field } }` reads its offset from a numeric column of the **same** record only, and the "B′" option, an offset read through a declared to-one path, was not taken. hotclm's review SLA is per contract **type**: `clm_contract_type.review_sla_days` is 2, 3, 5 or 10 days across nine types. 「审查超 SLA」 is `review_started_at < now − contract_type.review_sla_days`, which still cannot be written.
- As a runtime filter, `addDays: { $field: 'contract_type.review_sla_days' }` answers `400 INVALID_FILTER` with "the addDays offset … is a dotted path, and SQL push-down compiles same-table column references only".
- As a dataset measure filter (dataset `include: ['contract_type']`), it answers the same `400 INVALID_FILTER` with the reason withheld.
- The same anchor with a literal `-30` answers 200.

**Author-time hole.** `os validate` exits 0 on that measure filter. An author gets green gates and a tile that errors on every read. Whichever answer the platform gives below, `validate`/`lint` should refuse an `addDays` `$field` path the runtime will refuse. The seam is `NowAnchorSchema.addDays.$field` (`packages/spec/src/data/filter.zod.ts`) against the driver-sql same-table rule.

**Asked.** Either reopen B′: let `addDays.$field` follow a declared to-one lookup path (one hop is enough here), compiled as a join or subquery. Or rule it out for good. hotclm's maintainer ruled (hotclm#31, 6396322580 C) to keep the goal and wait for the platform rather than stamp an SLA column in the app, so a "no" here comes back to that maintainer. The cost line: this amends #25808's ruling A.

**Consumer.** objectstack-ai/hotclm #31 (Blocked-by this card). The durations half landed on 18.2.0's `duration` measure (#25778), and over-SLA is the remaining half. Evidence: hotclm PR #168 body and its os-dev-report on hotclm#31.

**Duplicate search.** objectstack issues, all states: "$now addDays dotted path", "now anchor offset related record", "INVALID_FILTER addDays dotted". Matches: #25808 (closed, ruling A, this card's parent) and #26301 (skills). No open duplicate.
